 Order

This i s first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.14/2023 dated 15.01.2023 registered at Police Station Sukhi Sevaniya, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 342, 366-A, 376-D of IPC and Section 5(G)/6 of POCSO Act,2012.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 24.01.2023 and trial will take considerable time to be concluded.
He further submits that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
He further submits that applicant is a permanent resident of district and is ready t o furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

According to prosecution, in the night of 15.01.2023 at around 10:00 p.m. when the prosecutrix was going to her home, she was abducted by the applicant and co-accused person and was taken to a deserted place where the co-accused raped her while applicant was standing outside.
The mobile tower location report suggests that at the given time applicant was in the same place where the co-accused was present.
Looking to the act of applicant and the crime registered against him, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE Nitesh Tikaram @ Tiku Ahirawara vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45936571/
